title: It Started with a Hockey Game — and 140 Bulldogs

copy.intro: In December 1999, Ferris State University hockey was headed west.
copy.background: The Bulldogs were coming to Colorado to compete in a Holiday Classic against the University of Denver, Boston University, and Air Force. For Ferris alumni living more than 1,200 miles from Big Rapids, it was a rare opportunity to see the Bulldogs play close to home.
copy.ideaIntro: One Ferris State alumnus had an idea:
copy.idea: What if we could get all the Bulldogs in Colorado together?
copy.invitation: So, he rented the President’s Box at the University of Denver and started inviting every Ferris State alumnus he could find in the Mile High City.
copy.question: Would anybody actually show up?
copy.turnout: More than 140 Ferris State alumni and friends came together that night.
copy.beginning: What started as an invitation to watch a hockey game became something much bigger. It was the beginning of a Colorado community built around a shared connection to Ferris State — and the first of many events designed to bring Bulldogs together far from Big Rapids.
copy.birth: The Mile High Bulldogs were born.
copy.continuation: Since December 1999, we’ve continued bringing Ferris State alumni together throughout Colorado to reconnect with old friends, meet new Bulldogs, celebrate our university, and have a whole lot of fun along the way.
copy.closingIntro: More than 25 years later, the idea remains pretty simple:
copy.closing: You may be a long way from Big Rapids, but you’re never far from your fellow Bulldogs.
